title: Thread links
responsibility: Groups existing conversations by whether they belong to the image currently in view.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.threads
inputs.description: Required thread records, kept in supplied order within each group. Empty groups are omitted.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.thread
inputs.description: Required current thread or null. Its identifier marks the matching button active and pressed.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.aim
inputs.description: Required image/conversation target used by the same-image helper to classify threads.

inputs.name: ThreadLinks.select
inputs.description: Called with the clicked thread; this component does not update the current-thread prop itself.

outputs.name: ThreadLinks
outputs.description: Threads on this image followed by Other threads. Buttons show the pin number and version, falling back to Initial plan. Empty input renders no groups.
